# Characterizing Behaviour-Driven Biopsychosocial Subtypes of Pediatric Concussion

This book contains documented R code (formatted as .qmd files) used to identify and characterize biopsychosocial subtypes of pediatric concussion in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study that are driven by separation across behavioural measures.

Each chapter is made of quarto (.qmd) files in the github repository [BRANCHlab/abcd-snf](https://github.com/BRANCHlab/abcd-snf).

To work through the code used, you will need:

* R (at least version 4.1.0)
* The `abcdutils` package, available at [BRANCHlab/abcdutils](https://github.com/BRANCHlab/abcdutils)
* Access to the following ABCD (5.0 release) data files:
    * ph_p_otbi.csv
    * abcd_y_lt.csv
    * ph_y_pds.csv
    * ph_p_pds.csv
    * gish_p_gi.csv
    * gish_y_gi.csv
    * abcd_p_demo.csv
    * ph_p_mhx.csv
    * mri_y_smr_vol_aseg.csv
    * mri_y_smr_thk_dst.csv
    * mri_y_smr_thk_dsk.csv
    * mri_y_smr_area_dst.csv
    * mri_y_smr_area_dsk.csv
    * mri_y_rsi_rnd_at.csv
    * mri_y_rsi_rnd_wm_dsk.csv
    * mri_y_rsi_rnd_wm_dst.csv
    * mri_y_rsfmr_cor_gp_gp.csv
    * mri_y_rsfmr_cor_gp_aseg.csv
    * mh_y_or.csv
    * nt_p_stq.csv
    * ph_p_saiq.csv
    * ph_y_yrb.csv
    * ce_y_psb.csv
    * ce_p_psb.csv
    * ce_y_fes.csv
    * ce_p_fes.csv
    * mh_p_asr.csv
    * mh_p_cbcl.csv
    * ph_p_sds.csv
